signatures.description: Implement an explicit-state model checker for a small TLA-like spec language (integer state vars, boolean guards, a next-relation of guarded assignments) that must emit every reachable state violating the invariant plus a shortest counterexample trace, or prove the invariant holds. Requirements: exact state hashing with collision re-verification (never trust the hash alone), symmetry reduction by canonicalizing interchangeable process slots so that soundness is preserved (states differing outside a symmetry class must never be merged), and termination on unbounded depth via visited-set cycle detection. The harness feeds specs with 100k+ reachable states and asserts identical violation sets with symmetry reduction both on and off, plus identical trace validity under replay.
